name: Underused Housing Tax — eliminated from the 2025 calendar year
description: The federal Underused Housing Tax (1% annual tax mainly on non-resident, non-Canadian owners of residential property) no longer applies for 2025 and later calendar years; obligations for 2022–2024 remain.

attributes.status: eliminated for 2025 and later calendar years
attributes.legislation: Budget 2025 Implementation Act, No. 1 — royal assent 26 March 2026 (as reported by the CRA)
attributes.prior_years: 2022–2024 filing, tax, penalties and interest still apply
